description: This file defines the Chroma_VectorStores class implementing the INode interface, providing methods for upserting and deleting data in a Chroma vector store, as well as initializing the vector store with configuration. It includes logic for handling credentials, configuration, and interaction with the Chroma database.

classes.name: Chroma_VectorStores
classes.description: Implements a vector store node for Chroma, supporting upsert, delete, and initialization functionalities.

methods.name: vectorStoreMethods
methods.description: Contains methods for upserting and deleting data in the Chroma vector store.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the vector store with configuration, returning a retriever or vector store object based on output type.
